description: Core TypeScript foundation: types, pure calculation utilities, Firebase config, sample data, and Firestore layer. This FEAT creates all the pure-TS business logic that pages and components depend on. It is independent of React UI. Depends on FEAT-001 (TypeScript toolchain must be installed).
steps: Create src/types/index.ts with the exact TypeScript interfaces from the spec: ConsumptionInput, TariffPlan, BillBreakdown, FingerprintLabel (union type), UsageFingerprint, BreakEvenResult, RiskScenario, RiskShieldResult, RegretResult, ShiftScenario, ComparisonResult. Copy the exact field names and types verbatim from the spec.

Create src/utils/formatCurrency.ts: export function formatCurrency(value: number): string using Intl.NumberFormat with style:'currency', currency:'INR', minimumFractionDigits:2, maximumFractionDigits:2. Also export formatRupees as an alias for backward compatibility with existing code that imports from formatRupees.js.

Create src/utils/validation.ts: export validateConsumption(input: Partial<ConsumptionInput>): Record<string, string> that validates offPeak/shoulder/peak are non-negative finite numbers, returns error messages keyed by field name. Export validateTariffPlan(plan: Partial<TariffPlan>): Record<string, string> that validates rates are non-negative finite numbers.

Create src/data/samplePlans.ts with the exact SAMPLE_PLANS array and DEMO_PROFILES array from the spec. SAMPLE_PLANS must have exactly two plans: plan-flat-saver (fixedCharge:120, all rates 6.25, taxDutyPercent:0, surcharge:0) and plan-smart-tou (fixedCharge:150, offPeakRate:4.25, shoulderRate:6.00, peakRate:9.00, taxDutyPercent:0, surcharge:0). DEMO_PROFILES must have exactly three profiles: Balanced Household (offPeak:120, shoulder:150, peak:80), Peak-Heavy Household (offPeak:70, shoulder:110, peak:170), Small Daytime Business (offPeak:90, shoulder:300, peak:160). Verify mentally: Balanced (total=350, peak%=22.9%) → Smart TOU wins; Peak-Heavy (total=350, peak%=48.6%) → Flat Saver wins.

Create src/utils/billingEngine.ts implementing calculateBill(consumption: ConsumptionInput, plan: TariffPlan): BillBreakdown with the exact formulas from the spec. offPeakCharge = offPeak * offPeakRate; shoulderCharge = shoulder * shoulderRate; peakCharge = peak * peakRate; energyCharge = sum; fixedCharge = billingPeriod === 'bimonthly' ? plan.fixedCharge * 2 : plan.fixedCharge; subtotal = energyCharge + fixedCharge + plan.surcharge; duty = subtotal * plan.taxDutyPercent / 100; estimatedTotal = subtotal + duty; effectiveCostPerKwh = total > 0 ? estimatedTotal / total : 0. Also export compareAllPlans(consumption: ConsumptionInput, plans: TariffPlan[]): BillBreakdown[] sorted by estimatedTotal ascending.

Create src/utils/digitalTwin.ts implementing classifyFingerprint(consumption: ConsumptionInput): UsageFingerprint with the exact threshold logic from spec: peakShare >= 45 → 'Peak-Heavy Household'; offPeakShare >= 45 → 'Off-Peak Optimiser'; shoulderShare >= 50 → 'Daytime Dominant' (or 'Daytime Small Business' if consumerType === 'small-business'); otherwise → 'Balanced Household'. Each label must include an explanation string describing the usage pattern and what it means for tariff choice. Export generateFingerprint as the main function.

Create src/utils/breakEvenEngine.ts implementing findBreakEven(consumption: ConsumptionInput, plans: TariffPlan[]): BreakEvenResult. Algorithm: keep total constant and shoulder constant; iterate peak share from 0% to 100% using binary search to find the crossover point where the cheapest plan changes. The binary search must converge within 50 iterations (tolerance 0.01%). If no crossover exists within the tested range, set crossoverExists: false and explain which plan dominates. Never hardcode the crossover value — compute it from the actual plan rates.

Create src/utils/riskShield.ts implementing generateRiskShield(consumption: ConsumptionInput, plans: TariffPlan[], recommendedPlanId: string): RiskShieldResult. Generate 25 scenarios (5 consumptionMultipliers × 5 peakShiftDeltas). consumptionMultipliers: [0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.2]; peakShiftDeltas: [-15, -10, 0, +10, +15] percentage points. For each scenario: clamp peak share to [0, 100], redistribute remainder proportionally between offPeak and shoulder (maintain their original ratio), ensure no negative values, calculate bill per plan using billingEngine. Aggregate planStats (scenariosWon, stabilityPercent, maxCost, avgCost, worstCaseCost, bestCaseCost). Calculate recommendationConfidence = (scenarios where recommended plan has lowest cost / 25) * 100. Identify cheapestToday, mostStablePlan, lowestWorstCasePlan.

Create src/utils/regretGuard.ts implementing calculateRegret(riskShield: RiskShieldResult, selectedPlanId: string): RegretResult. For each scenario: regret = bills[selectedPlanId] - min(bills in scenario). Compute avgRegret and maxRegret. Include maxRegretScenario reference and an explanation string like 'Plan X saves ₹Y today, but could cost up to ₹Z more if peak usage rises significantly.'

Create src/utils/shiftAdvisor.ts implementing generateShiftScenarios(consumption: ConsumptionInput, plans: TariffPlan[], originalBills: BillBreakdown[]): ShiftScenario[]. For shiftPercent in [10, 20, 30]: unitsShifted = peak * (shiftPercent / 100); newPeak = peak - unitsShifted; newOffPeak = offPeak + unitsShifted; shoulder unchanged; total unchanged. Calculate bills per plan with new consumption, savings vs original per plan, check if recommendation changes. Return array of 3 ShiftScenarios.

Create src/utils/recommendationEngine.ts implementing generateComparison(consumption: ConsumptionInput, plans: TariffPlan[]): ComparisonResult. Orchestrates all five novelties: calculates bills, generates fingerprint, runs break-even, runs risk shield, runs regret guard, runs shift advisor, produces a natural-language explanation string ('Based on your usage pattern, Plan X is recommended...'), sets timestamp to new Date().toISOString().

Replace src/firebase/config.ts (create fresh) with the exact Firebase config pattern from the spec: read all six VITE_FIREBASE_* env vars from import.meta.env; const isConfigured = !!(apiKey && projectId); const app = isConfigured ? (getApps().length ? getApp() : initializeApp(config)) : null; export auth, db, isConfigured. Import getAuth, getFirestore from firebase/auth and firebase/firestore respectively.

Replace src/lib/firestore.ts (create fresh) with WattWise Firestore functions. Firestore paths: users/{uid}/comparisons/{id} and users/{uid}/customPlans/{planId}. Export: saveComparison(uid: string, result: ComparisonResult): Promise<string>; getComparisons(uid: string): Promise<ComparisonResult[]>; deleteComparison(uid: string, id: string): Promise<void>; saveCustomPlan(uid: string, plan: TariffPlan): Promise<string>; getCustomPlans(uid: string): Promise<TariffPlan[]>; deleteCustomPlan(uid: string, planId: string): Promise<void>. Each function checks if db is null and throws 'Firebase is not configured' for writes, returns [] for reads. Use the firebase/firestore modular SDK (collection, doc, addDoc, getDocs, deleteDoc, serverTimestamp).

Update firestore.rules to match the spec exactly: rules_version '2'; match /databases/{database}/documents; match /users/{userId}/{document=**}: allow read, write if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId; match /{document=**}: allow read, write if false.
acceptance_criteria: Running `npm run test` passes all tests including new billingEngine, digitalTwin, breakEven, riskShield, regretGuard, shiftAdvisor tests (these test files are created in FEAT-004)
src/types/index.ts exports all 11 interfaces/types from the spec

SAMPLE_PLANS Balanced Household → Smart TOU wins: billingEngine.calculateBill({offPeak:120,shoulder:150,peak:80,total:350,...}, SAMPLE_PLANS[1]).estimatedTotal < billingEngine.calculateBill({...}, SAMPLE_PLANS[0]).estimatedTotal

SAMPLE_PLANS Peak-Heavy → Flat Saver wins: billingEngine.calculateBill({offPeak:70,shoulder:110,peak:170,total:350,...}, SAMPLE_PLANS[0]).estimatedTotal < billingEngine.calculateBill({...}, SAMPLE_PLANS[1]).estimatedTotal
breakEvenEngine.findBreakEven returns crossoverExists:true for the two sample plans with the Balanced Household profile
riskShield.generateRiskShield returns exactly 25 scenarios, all with non-negative consumption values
src/firebase/config.ts exports auth, db, isConfigured (all null/false when env vars absent)
npm run build — no TypeScript compilation errors
verification: npm run test — all tests pass
npm run build — succeeds without TypeScript errors
findings: All 13 steps implemented and verified. Recommendation-switching confirmed: Balanced Household (offPeak=120,shoulder=150,peak=80,total=350) → Smart TOU total=2280 < Flat Saver total=2307.50 (Smart TOU wins). Peak-Heavy (offPeak=70,shoulder=110,peak=170,total=350) → Flat Saver total=2307.50 < Smart TOU total=2637.50 (Flat Saver wins). breakEvenEngine uses binary search (max 50 iterations, 0.01% tolerance), never hardcodes crossover. riskShield generates exactly 25 scenarios (5 multipliers × 5 peak deltas), all non-negative. src/firebase/config.ts exports auth/db/isConfigured (all null/false when env absent). src/lib/firestore.ts is NEW, does not replace firestore.js. All 96 existing tests still pass. npm run build succeeds with no TypeScript errors. Committed as 6ca5bfa.
